title: feat(plugin-chatbot): an ask answer that saved drafts shows a draft review card, from a new spec part data-draft-review
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSvcG4raZAWqmz5wsaKvKxr)_

Fixes #38048

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到的变化：管理员在问 AI 对话里让 AI 搭建、AI 存下草稿后，回答下面多出一张卡，列出这一轮存的每个草稿、能否发布或有几个问题，并带去 Studio 审阅和发布的链接。
- 为什么做：属于「问 AI 搭建」专题（cloud 管理员技能），管理员不用再去 Studio 里找刚才存了什么。
- 出问题会怎样：最坏是卡片不出现，回答照常显示；卡上没有发布或丢弃按钮，不会误改数据，回滚这一个合并即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**Spec (`packages/spec/src/ai/draft-review.zod.ts`).** New in `@objectstack/spec/ai`: `DRAFT_REVIEW_PART_TYPE = 'data-draft-review'`, `DRAFT_REVIEW_MAX = 50` and `DraftReviewListSchema` with its row, verdict, verdict-refusal and links schemas and types. The five new objects are closed (an unknown key is refused); the findings in `refusals` / `advisories` keep the door's own `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` shape, which drops a key it does not know. Final part shape (cloud#5172 follows it):

```
{ type: 'data-draft-review', id: 'draft-review', data: {
    drafts: [{                                   // 1..50, save order, one row per draft (unique by package+type+name)
      type, name, package,                       // non-empty strings
      label?,                                    // non-empty string
      verdict: { publishable, refusals: RuntimeAuthoringIssue[], advisories: RuntimeAuthoringIssue[] } | null,
      verdictWithheld?: { code, message, status },
      verdictError?: { code, message, status },
      verdictRead: 'turn-end' | 'save',
      review: { changes, item },                 // Console paths: one leading slash, never two, no backslash/whitespace/control char
    }],
    omitted?: number } }                         // integer >= 1, absent when none
```

Refinements against the card's sketch, per the seat ruling on the claim: `refusals` / `advisories` reuse `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` (`@objectstack/spec/api`), the shape the door's `list_drafts` verdict returns. Also: `verdict` must be present (`null`, never left out); `verdictWithheld` / `verdictError` carry the door's own `{ code, message, status }`; `review` is closed at `{ changes, item }`, so the door's `note` is not forwarded; `drafts` holds at least one row; both review links must be Console paths that stay on the site, since the card renders them as anchors and hands them to `navigate`: one leading `/`, never `//`, and no backslash, whitespace or control character anywhere (a browser reads `/\host` and `/<tab>/host` as `//host`; the `@objectstack/types` builders percent-encode every segment, so their links pass). `drafts` has one row per draft, unique by `package`, `type` and `name`: a draft saved more than once in the turn is one row, placed at its first save, with the verdict read last; the cap and `omitted` count drafts, not saves.

**Chat (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot`).**
- `mapMessages.ts`: `extractDraftReview(parts)` reads the last `data-draft-review` part through `DraftReviewListSchema`; a refused part is `undefined`. `uiMessageToChatMessage` sets `draftReview` on the message. It is not added to `STORED_ANSWER_DATA_PARTS` or `storedAnswerData` (seat ruling Q2 = A, live only).
- `chat/DraftReviewCard.tsx` (+ `chat/draftReviewGroups.ts`): rows grouped by package in save order; per row the label or name, the type, a verdict badge (will publish / N problems / verdict withheld, with the door's message as its title) and a Review link to `review.item`; "checked when saved" when `verdictRead` is `save`; per package one "Review and publish" link to `review.changes`; `omitted` as "+N more". No button at all (seat ruling Q1 = A).
- `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` draws the card under the answer, after the record citations. New optional props `onOpenReviewLink(path)` (a plain left click navigates in the app, so the live-only card is still there) and `reviewLinkHref(path)` (the anchor href, for a new tab). `chatMessageAdapter.ts` lists `draftReview` among the runtime-only message keys.
- `index.tsx` exports `DraftReviewCard`, `DraftReviewCardProps` and `extractDraftReview`.

**Console (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/ChatPane.tsx`).** Wires `onOpenReviewLink` to `navigate` and `reviewLinkHref` to `documentHref(useHref('/'), path)`, so the href carries the console's basename.

**Strings.** `chatbot.draftReview.*` in the ten hand-written packs, `zh-Hant` regenerated; `problems` and `more` are plural families with every CLDR category each pack's language selects.

**Docs.** A "Draft review card" section on `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` and in the package README. Regenerated spec artifacts: api-surface, authorable-surface, declaration-map, export-origins, json-schema manifest, the `draft-review` reference page and its index entries, and the strictness-ledger AI counts.

Files to read first, by risk: `packages/spec/src/ai/draft-review.zod.ts` (the contract cloud builds to), `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/chat/DraftReviewCard.tsx` (link click handling), `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts` (`extractDraftReview` and that nothing stores it).

## Tests

Run on head `3a44ab65a` unless noted. Since `fb2070cda` the head changed only the spec module, its test, the generated reference page and the spec changeset; no UI file changed, so the UI readings marked `fb2070cda` stand.

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` → Test Files 910 passed (910), Tests 28811 passed, 1 todo. Includes `src/ai/draft-review.test.ts` (12 cases: the five new objects closed, `verdict` null but present, the 50 cap, `omitted` at least 1; review links refused for `https:`, `//`, `javascript:`, a relative path, the empty string, `/\evil.example/x`, a slash-tab-slash and a slash-newline-slash value, a space and a NUL, in both `item` and `changes`; a builder-shaped link with percent-encoded segments admitted; an unknown key on a finding dropped, keeping the door's shape).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/plugin-chatbot/` → Test Files 187 passed (187), Tests 2615 passed, 13 skipped.

## Acceptance notes

- A stream fixture with the part renders N rows with the right badges and links; a malformed part renders nothing; a turn without the part is unchanged: `DraftReviewCard-38048.test.tsx`.
- Accessible names: every link has an `aria-label` naming the draft or package and Studio; the card is a labelled `section`.
- Overflow in the eleven locales: measured in Chromium (Playwright, a temporary uncommitted Vite entry rendering `DraftReviewCard` through `I18nProvider`) at card widths 320 px and 280 px, for en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt-BR, ru and ar (RTL), with a long label, a long name, a long package name, 12 refusals and `omitted: 23`. In all 22 renders no element extends past the card, nothing scrolls sideways, and each of the three verdict badges is one line. Control: the same probe at 90 px reports the card scrolling and 21 spilling elements, so the probe can fail.
- Live only: a reloaded conversation shows no card (pinned: the part is not a kept data part).
- Nothing in this repository produces the part; the cloud admin skill does (cloud#5172).
- Surface beyond the claim: `chatMessageAdapter.ts` (one key in `RuntimeOnlyMessageKeys`), `chat/draftReviewGroups.ts` (the grouping helper, kept out of the component file for fast refresh), a second test file `DraftReviewCard.i18n-38048.test.tsx` (pack strings need their own file, because a mounted `I18nProvider` installs a module-level i18next global), and the extra prop `reviewLinkHref`. `core.ts` is not touched: `extractDraftReview` lives in `mapMessages.ts`, which the light core entry does not import.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/DraftReviewCard-38048.test.tsx` → 10 passed.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 110 families at `3a44ab65a` (the same list as at `fb2070cda`). All 110 ran on `3a44ab65a` after a build of every package under `packages/` (`turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'`, 83 tasks successful); 110 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "110 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 110 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".

- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` → exit 0: "126 published require entry point(s) across 74 package(s) load; 2593 emitted CommonJS file(s) parse".
- An earlier sweep on `61fee1dad` found two real reds, both fixed before `fb2070cda`: `check:llms-txt` (the `ai` row and the inventory heading now count `draft-review.zod.ts`) and `check:spec-parsed-alias` (ADR-0122 `…Parsed` twins for the verdict, refusal and links types).
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs a pinned commit a shallow clone lacks; fetching that one commit was enough, and it passed.

</details>
